candidate_definition.manual_suitability_review: permitted only by the sealed steward using metadata and mapping validity; exclusion reasons must be enumerated before labels are computed

reference_union: all model training and development antibody-antigen sequences
SABLE v0.2.0 train and analyst-exposed test sequences
all public SAbDab2 antibody-antigen instances released on or before the cutoff

task_routing.contact: baseline checkpoint from the same seed
task_routing.epitope: edge_topk2_supervised checkpoint from the same seed
task_routing.paratope: baseline checkpoint from the same seed

label_and_metric_definition.contact: minimum inter-residue non-hydrogen atom distance <= 4.5 angstrom
label_and_metric_definition.paratope_and_epitope: strict antibody- and antigen-axis any-contact marginals
label_and_metric_definition.primary_estimand: PDB-equal-weighted mean of per-complex AP after averaging the three fixed seeds
label_and_metric_definition.primary_report: point estimate and PDB-block bootstrap 95% confidence interval
label_and_metric_definition.zero_positive_policy: retain all samples in pooled metrics; exclude only zero-positive complexes from per-complex AP and report every eligible denominator

model_input_boundary.antibody_embedding: ABF-650M OAS-30B final residue hidden states
model_input_boundary.bound_structures: labels only, held by sealed steward until the one-time opening

opening_and_reporting.internal_fallback: single irreversible opening only after the frozen gate passes
opening_and_reporting.third_party_returns: signed aggregate metrics, denominators, bootstrap outputs, software/container hashes, checkpoint hashes, and audit receipt; no tuning interface

release_boundary.accumulation_rule: append every eligible release in chronological order; use the first immutable official snapshot that passes both opening minima; no candidate cherry-picking
release_boundary.eligibility: PDB initial_release_date is strictly later than cutoff_date_utc
release_boundary.scan_cadence: weekly after the Wednesday 00:00 UTC wwPDB release
release_boundary.source: official SAbDab2 all-summary metadata cross-checked against RCSB PDB initial release metadata

scientific_question: Prospective generalization to newly released antibody-antigen complexes that are cold on both antibody and antigen sequence axes.
